baseline_scope: The 67 development baselines are actual completed 0.34 active-confirmation runs. Fresh baseline runs load the saved 0.34 controller, experiment-candidate module, SC adapter, adoption policy, and claim compiler. No new objective-aware selection is retroactively inserted into this baseline.

policy.evidence: Paired constraint predictions made before each new optimizer observation; the research data fit both models but do not count as prior-adoption trials

evaluation.rule: Public evaluation coordinates and all final Program/GP predictions are frozen after each optimizer run. After every selected run is complete, a separate actual simulator stream supplies shared measurements and evaluator-only true constraint means. Evaluation calls never enter the controller and are reported separately.
evaluation.additional_requested_metrics: Record which experimental controls provide useful measured objective values, objective prediction errors on actual future observations, final objective-GP predictions on the same frozen independent controls when available, and the best measured point after the mechanism change. Preserve the original constraint Program/GP errors, confirmation and revision sequence, feasibility, and paid costs.

accounting: Research acquires 32 actual full objective/constraint vectors once per distinct initial task and shares them across both arms and same-task stable/change profiles. All loaded calls count toward each arm's N64. New revision questions replace ordinary optimizer calls inside the same remaining 32 calls; full history is retained. Historical reuse, new acquisition, extra model compute, and independent evaluation calls are separate.
metrics: final Program and active GP generalization MSE
common misfit, question, fresh validation, and scope adoption sequence
scope: All previous 67 cases are development, including the previous three one-off-outlier controls. Three previously unused seeds at noise0 and noise0.03 with mechanism change, stable StatePolicy, and stable RZDT2 make 18 new confirmation cases. Three separate noisy StatePolicy stress cases add exactly one +1.0 constraint observation at stage45 without a mechanism change. Compare all groups separately, preserve regression cases, and keep every optimizer arm within 32 initial plus32 online actual calls.
reuse_accounting: Reuse all previously paid initial vectors, actual 0.34 baseline runs, and independent evaluation measurements. Only the new arm reruns 67 development cases. Both arms run the 18 fresh confirmation and three fresh outlier stress cases. New and historical initialization, online observations, compute, and independent evaluation are separate.
baseline_revision_evidence: Keep the original four-observation batch size and nine-times-frozen-reference threshold. Nonoverlapping actual measurement batches reopen research when both models' batch MSE exceed the threshold and at least two individual rows exceed it for both models. The new scope starts at the earliest such counterexample and retains every subsequently paid row. Eight coverage calls and four fresh validation calls remain inside N64. No change labels, times, or truth values reach the controller.
research_initialization: Fresh initial data use MetaPriorResearch with the frozen0.34 claim compiler. The resulting candidate and actual full-vector data are identical across both arms. The existing public stratified completion rule supplies 32 initial rows when research finishes early; historical vectors are reused unchanged.

baseline_method.trigger: A current actual observation exceeds the unchanged nine-times-frozen-reference error threshold for both predictions made before that observation, while the ordinary sliding window does not yet support reopening.
baseline_method.reservation: One same-point confirmation, at least three new research controls, and four future validation calls must fit inside the original remaining budget.
baseline_method.confirmation: Repeat the same actual quantized control point. Freeze the anchor's two original pre-measurement means, target and threshold. The repeated target must exceed that frozen threshold for both original means and preserve each original residual's sign. Updated GP predictions, updated noise scales, change labels and evaluator truth do not decide confirmation.
baseline_method.confirmed: Begin the new evidence scope at the original anchor. Retain the previously frozen candidate competition; eight coverage controls may shrink with available budget, while four future validation calls remain reserved.
baseline_method.refuted: Keep every paid observation in the complete ledger, remove the original anomaly from the monitoring window, and resume ordinary optimization.
baseline_method.accounting: Record the actual same-point confirmation call with its purpose and cost. It replaces an ordinary optimizer query inside N64 and never adds an external simulator call.

outlier_control: The actual simulator runs normally and its constraint output receives the frozen +1.0 observation disturbance on the thirteenth online call only. Objectives, future measurements, and evaluator truth remain unchanged. A report-only log records the disturbance; the runtime receives only ordinary measured outputs and public controls. The corresponding ordinary stable case receives no disturbance. Initial data and final evaluation measurements are shared with that stable case.

new_method.unchanged: The 0.34 detector, actual anchor confirmation, constraint candidate compilation and competition, and training/future acceptance thresholds remain unchanged.
new_method.objective_model: Fit normalized affine and coordinate-additive quadratic objective programs using the current episode's paid full-vector observations. Select by leave-one-out prediction loss; retain frozen fold models. Prediction variance equals CV loss plus jackknife variance. This Gaussian expected-improvement proxy ranks actions and is not assumed to be a calibrated net-value estimator.
new_method.incumbent: The minimum paid objective in the current scope whose measured constraint satisfies the public constraint upper bound. No evaluator truth enters the controller. Without a feasible measured incumbent, each constraint candidate can offer its minimum predicted feasible objective point.
new_method.pool: Keep the existing public random and boundary pool. Add the analytic box-constrained minimum of the learned separable objective model and 33-point sweeps along every public coordinate through that learned minimum; no task-specific solution is supplied.
new_method.selection: Of four future validation controls, at most two use predicted feasibility and objective opportunity. Each constraint candidate offers its lowest predicted feasible objective point; choose the first offer by Gaussian expected improvement. Choose the second from the predicted-feasible pool by expected improvement times normalized squared distance to the first. Slots without positive opportunity return to disagreement selection. At least two controls retain disagreement times diversity. Missing objective data retains the original selector.
new_method.accounting: Charge all objective fits, held-out fit predictions, fold/pool objective predictions, and constraint predictions to the same existing compute budget. All selected controls consume the original N64 actual observations.
